purpose: Development benchmark for strengths: what a speaker does well on rate, pauses, tonality and pitch. The course coach's whole lessons are the reference for great delivery. Three kinds of evidence, all in source time: moments the coach performs and then names himself (praise), his deliberate demonstrations of a mistake, which must not be praised for that foundation (noPraise), and student readings before and after his coaching (pairs). Spans that are not the coach's own teaching (music, sketches, students, demonstrations) are listed under notTeaching and left out of his strengths per minute. Volume has no strength: recorded level can't be told from microphone gain, and the audio model can't hear projection.
segmentation: Whole lesson videos, decoded from the start of the file so source times hold. Times come from Deepgram nova-3 word times; demonstration and exclusion boundaries are taken from the rate, pause, volume, tonality and pitch development benchmarks.
